responsibility: Declares the generic path-probing machinery used by Rust HIR type and expression resolution. It defines PathProbeCandidate to classify enum, impl, and trait associated-item matches, PathProbeType to search a receiver type’s impls and bounds for a named segment, PathProbeImplTrait for searches constrained to a specific trait impl, and the helper used to report multiple-candidate ambiguities.
same_name_distinction: Declares the reusable path-probing infrastructure—PathProbeCandidate, PathProbeType, PathProbeImplTrait, and multiple-candidate reporting—used by resolution code. Unlike rust-hir-path-probe.cc, it defines the candidate model and probe interfaces rather than scanning impls, enums, and trait bounds.
